lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical lines are visible; spacing is approximately uniform through the mid-torso, with higher density and narrowing intervals observed towards the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible at the dorsal terminus of the fourth vertical line from the posterior, where the line splits into two distinct segments before reaching the dorsal crest.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 (anterior) and line 11 (posterior) are abbreviated, terminating before the mid-ventral line; line 6 exhibits a dashed morphology with a clear pixel gap in the mid-torso region.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots is located on the lower posterior haunch, situated in a non-uniform grouping above the tarsal joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the mid-posterior haunch align to form a semi-connected diagonal geometric line oriented approximately 30 degrees from the vertical axis.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature trajectory; horns emerge from the skull at an initial lateral angle of ~20 degrees, spiraling medially and posteriorly to converge at the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal horn tips is approximately 1.5 times the cumulative width of the two horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 15% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white dorsal crest of long hair extending from the cervical to the caudal region; distinct white facial chevron between the ocular orbits; high-contrast orange-tan coloration on all four distal limb segments.
